post.description: Creates a payment step for a saved intake flow. Every paid checkout validates a Cloudflare Turnstile token. Small Claims flows must use provider=authorize_net and create an Authorize.Net Accept Hosted token. Activation Hero flows must use provider=shift4 and receive a Shift4 Components draft containing the server-calculated amount and currency. The frontend securely tokenizes card data with Shift4.js, completes 3D Secure when required, and sends the resulting one-time token to the Shift4 confirmation endpoint. provider=zero_amount is valid for either service only when the recalculated total is zero and does not require Turnstile. The API rejects an external provider that does not match the intake flow service.
